reason: Notion workspace free-block quota exhausted — notion-create-pages fails; update-page still works
clear_when: a notion-create-pages call succeeds (plan upgraded or blocks freed) — set active:false and record cleared_at

matching.evidence_source: C:\Users\Owner\.claude\scheduled-tasks\_shared\send-log.txt — '[OK] Sent' lines only. Outlook Sent Items may corroborate but never substitutes: only the send-log records bytes=.
matching.normalize_subject: Fold the dash family (em dash, en dash, figure dash, minus) to '-', drop every non-ASCII character (emoji), collapse whitespace, compare case-insensitively (same as _shared/outlook-sent-probe.ps1 Normalized mode).
matching.pattern_syntax: fallback_email_subject_pattern and must_not_match are regular expressions applied with search to the NORMALIZED subject. Patterns are ASCII lookaheads so tokens match in any order.
matching.send_date: Convert the logged ISO offset to ET before taking the date — the log carries -04:00 and +02:00 lines.
matching.undated_subjects: A pattern with no date placeholder starts with the negative lookahead ^(?!\s*(re|fw|fwd):) and counts only if the line's ET send date equals the expected date.
matching.delivery_proof: EMAIL-ONLY requires one [OK] Sent line that matches fallback_email_subject_pattern, does NOT match must_not_match, has bytes >= min_bytes, on the expected ET date. A pattern match that hits must_not_match or has bytes < min_bytes is a 'fallback notice without report body' and escalates as before.
matching.null_pattern: fallback_email_subject_pattern null = no email path that can prove delivery while Notion create is blocked; a missing output escalates exactly as before (the producer is DARK).
matching.dark_on: Names the run path(s) on which a producer's only output is Notion; a missing page on that path has no email proof and escalates as before.

known_side_effects.effect: Its double-fire dedupe guard (SKILL.md L52-54) skips a block only when BOTH the email AND the Notion page exist. While page creation is blocked the page never exists, so a double-fire re-sends the Block B (Outbox QC) and Block C (EOD Action Ledger) emails. Expect duplicate B/C emails on catch-up-burst days while degraded; not fixed here.
Block B's sentinel close expects --notion-page-id (SKILL.md L159); with no page the COMPLETE record may be weaker while degraded (observation, not verified live).
Dedups against its own prior Notion post (L24); blocked posts lose that history, so it may re-flag already-reported deals after recovery.
